items.title: Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source Security Update (BlockStrap)
items.summary: This update addresses 11 vulnerabilities, including a critical template engine injection (CVE-2026-103849, CVSS 10.0) known as BlockStrap, which could lead to unauthenticated remote code execution. While Adobe is not aware of in-the-wild exploitation, Sansec has reproduced multiple attack routes.

items.title: Critical PHP Vulnerability Affecting Magento and other E-commerce Platforms
items.summary: A critical vulnerability in PHP itself, disclosed on October 21, 2026, affects Magento and other e-commerce platforms, allowing unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary code or read data. This issue requires updating PHP on the server, not just the Magento software.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce (StyleSmuggler)
items.summary: This out-of-band security update resolves a critical template engine injection vulnerability (CVE-2026-75650, CVSS 10.0) known as StyleSmuggler, which could result in arbitrary code execution. Adobe is aware that this vulnerability is being actively exploited in the wild.

items.title: Security update available for Adobe Commerce and Magento Open Source
items.summary: This security update addresses multiple critical, important, and moderate vulnerabilities that could lead to security feature bypass and privilege escalation. Adobe is not aware of any exploits in the wild for the issues covered in this bulletin.
